This appears to come from a CBP ruling or ITC case on airbag inflator bottles. The product is a seamless cold-rolled steel tube with an outside diameter of 35.04 mm and a wall thickness of 2.52 mm. Heading 7304 covers seamless tubes, pipes and hollow profiles of iron or steel.

For 7304, the 7304.31 subheadings cover cold-drawn or cold-rolled seamless tubes of iron or non-alloy steel, with other line pipe, casing and tubing in 7304.39 and 7304.51 for other alloy steel. The "bottle" is a pressure vessel for an airbag inflator, so heading 7311 (containers for compressed or liquefied gas, of iron or steel) could apply. But the product is a tube that is cut to length and not yet closed or finished, so it stays in 7304.

The airbag inflator tube case is likely the antidumping duty case on "certain seamless carbon and alloy steel tubes." The HTS code would then be 7304.31.6050, the cold-drawn seamless tubes of non-alloy steel, with circular cross-section, outside diameter under 38.1 mm. Statistical suffixes under 7304.31.60 are 7304.31.6010 (aligned), 6020 (aligned, other), 6050 (other). The 7304.31.60 category covers cold-drawn or cold-rolled of circular cross-section, other than line pipe, casing, tubing and drill pipe (the "other" group). I'll use 7304.31.6050.
